{"aggs":[],"params":{"fontSize":11,"markdown":"### ModSecurity WAF Audit Log

`jt-modsecurity` · rules 133500-133599

Decoder and graded rules for the ModSecurity v3 JSON audit log (libmodsecurity 3 with the OWASP Core Rule Set, e.g. in front of nginx). Reports the CRS verdict, not every rule hit: a request over the anomaly threshold that reached the application in detection-only mode, code-injection families, blocked requests, leaking responses and body errors, with the client address as srcip so that repeats per address, address lists and active responses work.

Discover query:

`rule.id:[133500 TO 133599] AND rule.id:/[0-9]{6}/`","openLinksInNewTab":false},"title":"jt-modsecurity · About","type":"markdown"}
